name: Level 25: Microkernel Context Switcher
description: The Ultimate OS Kernel Challenge! Process 1 PCB is stored in RAM 0..3 [11,22,33,44]. Process 2 PCB is stored in RAM 4..7 [55,66,77,88]. Read Process IDs [1, 2] from Inbox (0,1). Load selected Process PCB into R0..R3, increment each register by 1 (Context Save), write back to RAM PCB, and drop sum of R0..R3 into Outbox (4,1)!
